page.layout: One page of text; a decorative headpiece at the top; a large dedication title in capitals and roman; a smaller dedicatee line below; a historiated initial with italic text beside it; a signature line at the foot. No margin notes. A library stamp at right is ignored.

main_text.l: sky à Petrzwald, Generosi Dn. Hanussu
Bernhardo Skrbensky à Hrzisstie, Generosi Domini
Iaroslai Skrbensky à Hrzisstie, in Kunczicz,
Marescballi, filio, Dominis ac fautoribus plurimum

page.notes: The initial S is a large woodcut historiated initial and is not transcribed as text. The stamp "BIBLIOTECA NAZ. ROMA VITTORIO EMANUELE" is a library stamp and is omitted. Doubtful readings: "Marescballi" may be "Marescalli" in the print; the word "Subiecta" is set as "Vbiecta" with a long s form and is read as printed; the catchword "Quippe" is set at the foot right. The dedication title's line breaks are approximate. The "Google" watermark is omitted.
